title: 第3章 杀气
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
杀气？沈炼眉头微挑了一下，他有些难以置信，一个不学无术的人身上居然会有杀气。
沈炼当年也上过战场，参加过萨尔浒之战，可以说见过的死人比活人还要多。
他发现一个特点，每一个战场上活下来的老兵，或者北镇抚司诏羁押的凶徒，身上或多或少的都有一种难以言诉的气势。
平时或许看不出来，一旦这些人发怒或者动手，这种气势就会自然而然的流露出来。
沈炼很是好奇，他觉得堂弟应该隐藏着些什么！
沈炼的眼光很独到，陈浩的确杀过人，而且不只杀过一个那么简单。
在21世纪陈浩是个孤儿，从小在孤儿院长大，他少时便极其好强，不光学习成绩出色，而且还跟食堂的退伍老兵学了一身本事。
长大后，陈浩考上了一所大学，原本他是没钱交学费的，幸亏天无绝人之路，就在这时一位善良的富商资助了包括陈浩在内的三名孤儿院走出的学生，圆了陈浩的大学梦。
尝尽人情冷暖的陈浩对这位富豪非常感激，甚至打算毕业后就去报效此人。
谁曾想这位富豪在陈浩毕业前夕竟被人杀害了，死亡地点在云缅边境，原因是绑匪撕票。
陈浩信奉的就是有仇必报，有恩必还，毕业后他去了云缅边境，于是就另辟捷径靠着应聘成了一名协警。
两年的探查，陈浩终于查到了绑匪在境外的落脚地。
在云缅边境的这两年陈浩已十分熟悉当地的情况，也结交了一些三教九流的人物，于是他通过蛇头的关系偷越了缅甸国境，凭着一把三棱军刺将这伙绑匪杀得一个不剩。
陈浩做事很干脆杀完人就走，也不怕有人追查他，毕竟是在境外，更何况缅甸国内正在爆发战争，谁能顾得上他!
重新回到华夏，陈浩又在派出所待了两个月，直到抓捕罪犯意外落崖......
见陈浩身上的气势愈发强烈，沈炼表面冷淡，心里却有些欣慰，不管这小子隐藏了什么，最起码能证明他不是孬种！
“不要磨磨唧唧了，赶紧来啊！”
陈浩大吼一声，他眼神坚定，只是脚步有些蹒跚，事实上他已然有了七分醉意！
“好！”
沈炼冷冷一笑，他随手将绣春刀抛向空中，然后使出一记普通的鞭腿动作，直往陈浩身上抽去。

这一腿势大力沉，以迅雷之势踢向还在保持军体拳起手式的陈浩。
面对沈炼迅疾的攻势，陈浩毫不慌张，甚至嘴角还露出了一丝笑容，颇有些嘲讽的意味。
陈浩习练军体拳足有十几年之久，可谓是军体拳里的高手，连侠客系统的评分都是‘小成境界’。
练拳这十几年，他也碰到过所谓的高手，可是那些人在陈浩手下都坚持不了几招。
原本初来乍到，以为沈炼必有高超的技法，未曾想沈炼的技法也是普普通通啊！
沈炼的这一记鞭腿太普通了，普通到戏班的学徒都会。
陈浩想都未想，他身子往下一矮，右臂护住脑袋，准备用右臂格挡沈炼的踢来的腿，同时左拳收于腰际，成左弓步，这记弓步冲拳是格挡之后的反击。
拳腿相交，传出砰的一声响动。
沈炼一个潇洒的转身，左手轻轻接住了空中掉落的绣春刀，这一记鞭腿很快，快到绣春刀尚未落到地上。
再看陈浩，已经晕厥在了广场上。
沈炼愕然“......”
我只用了五成力气好不好！！！
......
清晨，万籁俱寂，天蒙蒙亮。
沈炼起得很早，闻鸡而起武，他早已习惯这种生活节奏。
最初的时候他是和父亲叔父一起练武，后来叔父一家去了广州，再后来父亲公务繁忙，则变成了他自己一个人孤零零的练武，这一练就是一二十年！
当然从今天开始沈炼就不会孤单了，他会多一个陪练，因为他要严格训练堂弟沈长青，小时候堂弟十分懒惰宁愿睡大觉也不练武，再加他年龄小长辈宠爱，即使他不练也没人说什么！
沈炼觉得堂弟小时候就是被宠溺过了头，才造成了现在的恶果！
沈炼浩竟比他起的还早，而且还在做昨天早上那上下起伏的猥琐动作。
“大哥！”

陈浩有些尴尬的笑了笑，对沈炼的态度比昨日酒醉后好了太多。

content_en:
murderous look? Shen Lian raised his eyebrows slightly. He couldn't believe that an unlearned person could actually have murderous intent in his body.
Shen Lian also went to the battlefield and participated in the Battle of Salhu. It can be said that he saw more dead people than living people.
He discovered a characteristic. Every veteran who survived the battlefield, or the murderer detained by Fusi Zhao in Beizhen, had more or less an indescribable aura about him.
You may not be able to see it at ordinary times, but once these people get angry or take action, this momentum will naturally be revealed.
Shen Lian was very curious. He thought his cousin should be hiding something!
Shen Lian's vision was very unique. Chen Hao had indeed killed people, and not just one.
In the 21st century, Chen Hao was an orphan. He grew up in an orphanage. He was extremely strong when he was young. Not only did he have excellent academic performance, he also learned a skill from the veterans in the cafeteria.
After growing up, Chen Hao was admitted to a university. Originally, he had no money to pay for tuition. Fortunately, there is always a path. At this time, a kind-hearted wealthy businessman sponsored three students who came out of the orphanage, including Chen Hao, and Chen Hao's dream of going to university came true.
Chen Hao, who had experienced the ups and downs of human kindness, was very grateful to this rich man and even planned to serve him after graduation.
Who would have thought that this rich man was actually killed on the eve of Chen Hao's graduation. The place of death was at the border of Yunnan and Myanmar. The reason was that the kidnappers broke up with him.
Chen Hao believed in taking revenge and repaying kindness. After graduation, he went to the Yunnan-Myanmar border, so he took a shortcut and became a co-op by applying for a job.
After two years of investigation, Chen Hao finally found the kidnapper's overseas location.
In the past two years at the Yunnan-Myanmar border, Chen Hao had become very familiar with the local conditions and made friends with some people from all walks of life. So he sneaked across the Myanmar border through the connections of the smugglers and killed all the kidnappers with a three-edged military thorn.
Chen Hao simply kills people and leaves without fear of anyone tracking him down. After all, he is outside the country, not to mention that a war is breaking out in Myanmar. Who can take care of him!
Returning to China, Chen Hao stayed at the police station for another two months until the criminal he arrested accidentally fell off a cliff...
Seeing Chen Hao's aura getting stronger and stronger, Shen Lian looked cold on the surface, but felt a little relieved in his heart. No matter what this kid was hiding, at least it could prove that he was not a coward!
"Stop whining and whining, come quickly!"
Chen Hao roared, his eyes were firm, but his steps were a little staggering. In fact, he was already seventy percent drunk!
"Okay!"
Shen Lian smiled coldly, threw the Xiuchundao into the air, and then used an ordinary whip kick to whip it straight towards Chen Hao.
This leg movement was powerful and heavy, and it kicked with lightning speed towards Chen Hao, who was still maintaining the military fist stance.
Facing Shen Lian's rapid offensive, Chen Hao did not panic, and even showed a smile on his lips, which was quite sarcastic.
Chen Hao has been practicing military martial arts boxing for more than ten years. He can be said to be a master in military martial arts boxing. Even the score of the knight system is at the level of "little success".
In the more than ten years of practicing boxing, he has also encountered so-called masters, but those people could not hold on to a few moves under Chen Hao.
When I first came here, I thought that Shen Lian must have superb skills, but I never thought that Shen Lian's skills were just ordinary!
Shen Lian's whip kick was so ordinary that even the apprentices in the troupe could do it.
Without even thinking about it, Chen Hao lowered his body and protected his head with his right arm, preparing to block Shen Lian's kick with his right arm. At the same time, he closed his left fist at his waist and made a left lunge. This lunge punch was a counterattack after blocking.
The fists and legs met, and there was a banging sound.
Shen Lian turned around gracefully, and gently caught the Xiuchun Dao that fell in the air with his left hand. This whip was so fast that the Xiuchun Dao had not yet fallen to the ground.
Looking at Chen Hao again, he had fainted in the square.
Shen Lian was stunned "..."
I only used 50% of my strength, okay? ! !
......
In the early morning, everything is quiet and the sky is bright.
Shen Lian got up very early and jumped into action when he heard the chicken. He was already used to this rhythm of life.
At first, he practiced martial arts with his father and uncle. Later, his uncle's family went to Guangzhou. Later, his father was busy with official duties, so he practiced martial arts alone. This practice lasted for ten or twenty years!
Of course, from today on, Shen Lian will not be alone. He will have one more partner, because he has to strictly train his cousin Shen Changqing. When he was a child, his cousin was very lazy and would rather sleep than practice martial arts. Plus, he is favored by his elders, so even if he doesn't practice, no one will say anything!
Shen Lian felt that his cousin was spoiled too much when he was a child, which resulted in the current bad consequences!
Shen Lianhao actually got up earlier than him, and was still doing the obscene ups and downs he did yesterday morning.
"Brother!"
Chen Hao smiled awkwardly, and his attitude towards Shen Lian was much better than when he was drunk yesterday.
